architectureDecisions: D1 -- Verification-first: run the four feedback suites plus the two repo-root bridge/dependency contract tests on current main before adding recovery tests for N1-N6.
D2 -- The BB-083/BB-085 boundary is enforced by git provenance: lifecycle modules are excluded from sourceScope.write even though they share the package.
D3 -- GEPA bridge failure modes (N5/N6) are proved via the Node<->Python protocol test with GEPA_BRIDGE_CRASH_AFTER_COMMIT=1, asserting dispatch-count stability and receipt replay.

D4 -- Repair boundary: a defect found in the feedback contracts/controller/projection/improvement/bridge surface is repaired minimally on the exact ref, with regression evidence covering the defect and N1-N6.
implementationSlices: S1 -- Application ownership and lifecycle integrity [C1, C3, N1, N2]: principal roles, CAS revisions, idempotent recovery, frozen journal.
S2 -- Fail-closed context binding [C2, N3]: exact Oracle resolution identity, typed UNRESOLVED reasons, never a grounded episode on corrupt resolution.
S3 -- Deterministic projection [C4]: episode id dedupe, cohortKey-only grouping, contrary-evidence attachment, systemic proposal support+mechanism.
S4 -- Independent improvement handoff [C5, N4, N5]: scope freeze before search, holdout leak rejection, reserve-before-dispatch, decisive-margin IMPROVED.
S5 -- GEPA bridge orchestration [C6, N6]: budget-before-reservation, crash UNCERTAIN, reconcile replay, cancel SIGKILL with consumed reservation.
S6 -- Living Docs: feedback.md statements on contracts, authority boundaries, fail-closed semantics, explicit v1 limitations.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Only a principal with role application can create/revise FEEDBACK_RESPONSE_V1; observer/evaluator/provider/gepa/model principals are rejected by defineApplicationPrincipal and by createResponse/reviseResponse (no lifecycle mutation, no journal entry for rejected attempts).
evidenceRequired: Feedback package suites output on current main.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: createFeedbackProjector binds the exact Oracle ContextResolution identity (ref+digest+currentness+sourceObservationRef); missing/stale/digest-mismatched/subject-mismatched context yields an explicit UNRESOLVED binding with the correct typed reason (MISSING_CONTEXT/STALE_CONTEXT/RESOLUTION_DIGEST_MISMATCH/SOURCE_OBSERVATION_MISMATCH) and never produces a grounded episode.
evidenceRequired: Feedback package suites output on current main.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: createResponse starts at revision 1; reviseResponse is compare-and-swap (stale expectedRevision fails, current revision unchanged, never silently rebase); recoverResponse is idempotent (identical current revision, exactly one journal entry); recordOutcome binds the latest revision; IMPROVED/NO_CHANGE/REGRESSED require an evidenceRef, missing fresh evidence stays UNKNOWN (never IMPROVED); the journal is append-only and frozen.
evidenceRequired: Feedback package suites output on current main.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Episodes deduplicate by deterministic episode id; grouping happens ONLY on an explicit cohortKey (null cohortKey episodes never group); contrary evidence stays attached; proposeSystemic requires support >= 2 AND explicit mechanism evidence (frequency alone fails); reinforce records evidence without auto-escalation or state mutation.
evidenceRequired: Feedback package suites output on current main.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: freezeExperimentScope freezes HOW subject, optimizer identity, partitions (finalHoldoutSealed=true) and metric-policy ref+digest+minEffect BEFORE search; final-holdout membership/evidence anywhere in input is rejected; submitCandidate reserves the benchmark attempt BEFORE dispatch (null reservation or registerAttempt throw -> no proposal); optimizer accepted/promoted/verdict/score claims are ignored; the proposal envelope carries no acceptance flags; evaluateFinal returns IMPROVED only on decisive aggregate margin over the frozen minEffect, with critical regression dominating.
evidenceRequired: Feedback package suites output on current main.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: The GEPA bridge budget check runs BEFORE reserveAttempt; Node owns orchestration; a crashed/killed invocation yields UNCERTAIN with no auto-retry; reconcile replays the durable receipt without duplicate dispatch (dispatch-counts.json unchanged); cancel SIGKILLs the child and the reservation stays consumed (no refund); usageCost stays null; results never contain accepted/promoted/verdict keys.
evidenceRequired: Feedback package suites output on current main. Bridge protocol test output.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: createResponse/reviseResponse with evaluator/observer/provider/gepa/model principals -> FEEDBACK_CONTRACT_INVALID thrown, no record created, no journal mutation.
expectedRevision mismatch, or replaying the same expectedRevision twice -> fails with no silent rebase and the current revision unchanged.
Digest mismatch, stale currentness, wrong sourceObservationRef, malformed resolution, explicit null resolution -> fail closed to the correct UNRESOLVED reason, never a BOUND episode.
freezeExperimentScope input containing finalHoldoutMembers or finalHoldoutEvidence anywhere (nested included) -> throws; unsealed partitions and missing/non-finite minEffect -> throws.
Null reservation, registerAttempt throw, or bridge budget exhausted -> dispatch throws and the Python worker never spawns (no python process).

Adapter crash-after-commit (GEPA_BRIDGE_CRASH_AFTER_COMMIT=1) -> dispatch result UNCERTAIN; reconcile yields SETTLED_BY_RECONCILIATION replaying the same receipt with no duplicate dispatch (dispatch-counts unchanged, no receipt rewrite).
